skill.name: skill-creator
skill.description: Guide for creating or updating skills that extend Manus via specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations. For any modification or improvement request, MUST first read this skill and follow its update workflow instead of editing files directly.
skill.userDescription: Create, update, and improve Agent Skills with a guided workflow for instructions, scripts, resources, and testing.
exampleQuestions: Create a new Agent Skill for parsing CSV files and generating summary reports.
Update the existing translation skill to support Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese output.
Test and validate the script configuration for the data visualization skill.
